# SWAYA

> SWAYA is a next-generation, privacy-first offline media center and intelligent batch video organizer for Windows 10/11 desktop PCs.

SWAYA combines automatic metadata scraping (TMDb, OMDb, StashDB, FansDB, ThePornDB), physical file renaming on hard drives with Plex/Jellyfin-compatible folder templates, a GPU-accelerated 4K HDR MPV video player, custom themed lists, and a 1-click stealth vault mode. It runs 100% locally with zero cloud subscriptions and zero telemetry.

## Core Features & Concepts

- [Smart File Organizer](https://swaya.xyz/docs/organizer): Intelligent regex-based physical file renamer, auto TMDb/StashDB matching, collision-safe dry-run preview, and Plex/Jellyfin folder structure organization.
- [Offline Media Library](https://swaya.xyz/docs/library): Unified catalog for movies, TV series, episodes, scenes, performers, and studios with 4K artwork and offline SQLite database.
- [Embedded MPV Player](https://swaya.xyz/docs/player): Hardware-accelerated 4K HDR playback, multi-track audio & subtitle switching, custom shaders, and resume tracking.
- [Custom Collections & Lists](https://swaya.xyz/docs/lists): Dynamic and static themed collections with automatic 4-poster collage cover art generation.
- [Stealth Vault & Privacy](https://swaya.xyz/docs/settings): Instant global hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+H / Esc) stealth vault to obscure sensitive media libraries.
- [Torrents & External Client Dashboards](https://swaya.xyz/docs/torrent): Direct qBittorrent, Transmission, and Deluge integration inside the desktop app.
- [Scrapers & Metadata Providers](https://swaya.xyz/docs/organizer): Automated multi-provider metadata scrapers for mainstream and niche media.

## Comparisons & Alternatives

- [SWAYA vs FileBot](https://swaya.xyz/compare/filebot): Comparison of automated file renaming, preview safety, and licensing models.
- [SWAYA vs Plex](https://swaya.xyz/compare/plex): Offline desktop app vs server-client streaming architecture.
- [SWAYA vs tinyMediaManager](https://swaya.xyz/compare/tinymediamanager): Modern GPU-accelerated React/Electron interface vs Java tool.
- [SWAYA vs StashApp](https://swaya.xyz/compare/stash): Dedicated desktop experience vs local web server.
- [SWAYA vs Jellyfin](https://swaya.xyz/compare/jellyfin): Zero-transcoding direct disk playback vs network streaming.
- [SWAYA vs Kodi](https://swaya.xyz/compare/kodi): Modern desktop catalog curation vs home theater TV interface.

## Licensing & Architecture

- [Pricing & License](https://swaya.xyz/): One-time perpetual license (€39 introductory / €79 standard) for up to 3 personal Windows devices.
- [Terms & Refund Policy](https://swaya.xyz/terms): 14-day unactivated money-back guarantee and 7-day activated technical support guarantee.
- [Privacy Policy](https://swaya.xyz/privacy): 100% offline data processing with zero telemetry and local SQLite database (`data/swaya.db`).
- [Release Notes & RSS Feed](https://swaya.xyz/changelog): Version release notes and [RSS Feed](https://swaya.xyz/feed.xml).
- [Documentation Index](https://swaya.xyz/docs): Comprehensive 13-guide user manual and configuration handbook.
